communications.subject: Minnesota Government Data Practices Act Request: Richfield - Data sharing with LexisNexis
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

We are seeking information about current and previous data sharing with LexisNexis, including Community Crime Map (CCM), Accurint Crime Analysis (ACA), and Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC). 

1) The "AVCC XML Addendum" or "Consortium Sub-Agency Agreement" signed between your agency and LexisNexis Risk Solutions (also known as RELX, LexisNexis Risk Management, or Accurint). This is the document that indicates whether your agency’s RMS/CAD data has been shared with LexisNexis' AVCC subscribers. This document is sometimes attached to the overall agreement and Schedule A agreement between your agency and LexisNexis. 

2) Invoices issued by LexisNexis Risk Solutions to your agency during the last twelve months.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
